headline:
Buy one, get one 50% off.
A gift for little loved ones.
text: Two 9-Note rain drums, valued at {unit} each ({compare}). You pay {price} — the second one is 50% off. Keep one, and give one to a grandchild or a child you love. They ship in the same box, with no extra shipping.
title: 9-Note Rain Drum
why: Valued at {unit} each. The second is 50% off — save {save}.
bullets: Two 9-Note rain drums, each with its own mallet, ready to gift
Nine steel tongues in a pentatonic scale, so there’s no wrong note
Weather-resistant steel, made to sit outdoors year-round

quote.text: I bought these as Christmas gifts for my three adult children. Took one out and used the mallet and the clarity of the notes was amazing. I know they will love them!
quote.author: Peggy Fodness

reviews.text: I love them. I can't wait to give the other ones to my daughter's for Christmas. I'm positive they will love them as much as I do. Thank you. Christine
reviews.author: Christine Junkins

reviews.text: Unique gift and beautiful musical sounds. Great for Rainy Season and even fun to play.
reviews.author: Karen Davis

reviews.text: just as described, perfect size and sounds lovely! So excited to gift these:)
